title: Advance owned-title startup through the initial reserve/commit pair
goal: Reuse the verified selected SDK to return from the audited first allocation, capture and admit the following bounded commit call, execute the reviewed heap-initialization path and stop at the next unadmitted service; preserve existing checkpoints and prioritize actual boot progress.
acceptance: Bind exact executable/metadata/generation/compiler/SDK identities; independently audit original post-allocation PPC, branch targets, memory accesses, second-call setup and next diagnostic boundary before admitting each additional operation

Add explicit staged continuation inspection and execution modes with exact caller/value contracts, allocation/call/byte/deadline budgets, complete in/out and neighbouring-byte checks, and the original verified kernel export; keep unknown functions/indirect branches diagnostic and never use successful stubs or edit generated guest code

Validate reserve-to-commit output, allocation geometry, committed edge/access/accounting and unchanged unrelated state against an independent selected-fork oracle; audit executed title data accesses and capture the actual next service/caller without invoking it

Demonstrate bounded actual SP/MP startup progress with stopped-thread/runtime/mapping recovery on native Windows/Linux and supported sanitizer profiles; retain the historical header and first-allocation behaviors as explicit regressions

Reject changed identities, caller/argument/binding/pointer/result contracts, stale/reordered/incomplete/late evidence; preserve failures and split any demonstrated SDK defect; publish source-only evidence and keep first-frame/menu/playable gates incomplete
validation: Use focused Windows Campaign probes for development feedback, then repeated SP/MP acceptance and meaningful negative controls on supported native/host/core profiles with at most two build workers and one GPU-heavy suite per machine

Run public protocol/configuration/output-isolation tests, python tools/check.py and relevant supported platform/sanitizer checks; separately re-audit artifacts, actual loaded libraries and immutable input/generation/config/source identities

Report exact commands, observed next boundary, counts/hashes, retained failures/skips, resource budgets, performance impact and self-review; do not equate a passing probe or synthetic renderer with a playable test
size: bounded first reserve/commit startup segment and next-service stop; no new renderer, broad service allowlist or gameplay implementation
